description: Get up to 1,000 SEPA KiWIS observations by series_id over at most 7 days. Values retain upstream units and timestamps; provisional data may change (OGL). Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD; start/end must be ordered and at most 7 days apart.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

series_id.description: Numeric KiWIS series identifier returned by sepa_series.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD; start/end must be ordered and at most 7 days apart.

name: sepa_values
